propositions: Build a Jira Data Center transport on pycontribs/jira satisfying TicketTransport, SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, and SupportsAbsenceProbe, confined to an opt-in [jira-datacenter] extra and lazily imported so import rebar stays dependency-free.

Authenticate via a Personal Access Token read env-only from JIRA_PAT passed as bearer token_auth, with url and project from typed config and malformed config failing loudly with ConfigError rather than degrading.
Return raw payload shapes rebar's existing mappers consume so no jira.Issue leaks downstream, validated through the shared verified-fake shape contract used for the Cloud transport.

Mirror acli_rest retry semantics: retry transient connectivity faults (including builtin TimeoutError) with 2s/5s backoff, never retry HTTP errors, and raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError for unknown assignees.
Register the DC backend via a self-registration import in adapters/__init__.py so select_backend("jira-datacenter") resolves rather than raising BackendRegistryError at operator first run.

Enforce TLS verification never disabled (verify never False via the options dict), reject non-https base_url with ConfigError unless allow_insecure=true, support ca_bundle for internal CAs, and configure resolved_statuses for the absence probe defaulting to {Resolved, Done, Cancelled}.
